title: Survey Panel Firm Norstat Launches Expert Network Across 22 Countries
summary: Norstat launched an Expert Network giving clients access to verified senior business decision-makers, including CFOs, IT decision-makers, category leads, and security experts. The network is available in 22 countries and is led by Managing Director Carsten Broich; participants contribute through online surveys, expert interviews, and focus groups. Norstat, which acquired Sample Solutions in June 2025, lists private equity, investment and advisory firms, and management consultancies among typical clients.
whyItMatters: Established survey-panel operators are moving into expert-network territory from the quantitative side, mirroring expert networks' own expansion into B2B surveys.
